name: This Book
description: One book. The campaign lives here.

pages.title: This book
pages.text:
This is the **Whisker Codex**. One book. Right-click always opens these pages: what happened, what you do next, who kept the Loom.

There is no Shift-click mode. There is no second story hidden behind a modifier.

pages.title: The assignment list
pages.text:
The **Grave** key (backtick `` ` ``) opens the live assignment list — FTB Quests, checkmarks and rewards. That list is the **same campaign**, not a second book.

Come here to learn the braid. Open Grave when you want the next task in your hand.
